body:
## Parent

- #1734 — AKASHA-FALKOR-001
- Historical/reference proof: #1667 and PR #1725

## Publication posture

`public` — Rosetta-owned graph adapter/projection proving work. Protected backend tuning/optimization policy is out of scope.

## Objective

Implement and prove FalkorDB as the **active Akasha V0 operational graph projection backend** using the existing provider-neutral source/normalization/projection semantics.

This is a re-proof from canonical source + TRACE-NORM artifacts, **not** a Neo4j data migration.

## Historical-evidence rule

Do not rewrite or delete the Neo4j implementation/proof history. Preserve:

- #1667 issue body and comments;
- PR #1725;
- existing Neo4j profile identifiers;
- existing Neo4j proof/golden/batch-validation artifacts;
- existing FEATURE_LOG statements describing what was actually proven.

The Neo4j proof is a differential/reference oracle for this leaf.

## Required architecture

```
TRACE-SRC
  -> TRACE-NORM
  -> trace.projection.v1
      -> historical Neo4j adapter/proof
      -> active FalkorDB adapter/proof
```

`trace.projection.v1` remains backend-neutral. If current code mixes projection construction and Neo4j I/O, separate the provider-neutral construction without changing its semantic identity unless a genuine contract defect is discovered.

## Scope

1. Add a pinned local FalkorDB development/test runtime.
2. Use the official FalkorDB client/RESP path for the active adapter. Do not preserve Bolt merely for code similarity; FalkorDB documents Bolt as experimental.
3. Implement FalkorDB import/reset/export for `trace.projection.v1`.
4. Preserve stable node/edge identities, source lineage, temporal role boundaries, and scoped `projectionId` isolation.
5. Reuse the existing direct Cypher proof corpus wherever FalkorDB's OpenCypher support is semantically equivalent; fork only provider-specific query/setup surfaces.
6. Create required indexes before unique constraints. FalkorDB unique constraints require supporting exact-match indexes.
7. Treat FalkorDB constraint creation as asynchronous: poll `CALL db.constraints()` until required constraints are `OPERATIONAL`; fail on `FAILED`/timeout.
8. Verify indexes with `CALL db.indexes()`.
9. Produce a new FalkorDB proof artifact that records backend/version/image identity, graph name, constraint/index state, query outputs, closure digest, idempotency, scoped reset, and rebuild.
10. Differentially compare provider-neutral closure/query expectations with the historical Neo4j proof.
11. Remove Neo4j from the normal active V0 runtime path only after parity passes; retain a reference harness only if cheap enough to justify.
12. Keep FalkorDB fixture/local and non-authoritative. Public/network service use remains outside this leaf and requires SSPL review.

## Expected code migration

Candidate current surfaces include:

- `packages/projection-adapters/src/lib/neo4j-trace-projection.ts`
- `packages/projection-adapters/src/lib/agent-trace-neo4j.ts`
- corresponding specs/exports/package dependency
- `tools/trace-graph/start-neo4j.sh`
- `tools/trace-graph/docker-compose.yaml`
- `tools/trace-graph/prove.mjs`
- `tools/trace-graph/cypher/*.cypher`
- proof/evidence artifacts and README/docs/catalog references

Preserve historical Neo4j files/evidence where their names are part of already-landed receipts; do not rename history into FalkorDB.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A clean pinned FalkorDB runtime accepts the same golden provider-neutral projection inputs.
- [ ] No Neo4j database contents are used as migration input.
- [ ] Same source + TRACE-NORM -> same provider-neutral `trace.projection.v1`.
- [ ] Re-import creates no duplicate semantic nodes/relationships.
- [ ] Scoped reset removes only the named projection and leaves a sentinel/other graph state intact.
- [ ] Reset + rebuild reproduces the expected canonical provider-neutral graph closure.
- [ ] Direct Cypher reproduces run/window membership, parentage, request/result correlation, lifecycle, snapshot transitions, provenance traversal, bounded inspection, morphology, and neighborhood expectations required by the existing proof.
- [ ] Required FalkorDB indexes exist and required constraints reach `OPERATIONAL`.
- [ ] Source order/timestamps are not promoted into causal authority.
- [ ] Canonical source and Rosetta store remain unaffected when FalkorDB is absent/dropped.
- [ ] New `falkordb-proof` evidence records backend identity and passes against both existing fixtures.
- [ ] Existing Neo4j proof artifacts remain byte/history-preserved.
- [ ] Active local V0 instructions use FalkorDB rather than Neo4j.

## Dependencies / handoff

- Depends on the already-landed #1665/#1666/#1667 semantic/projection work.
- Blocks Falkor successors for TRACE-KIN and TRACE-TEMP under #1734.
- Executable leaf.

## Non-goals

- Production clustering.
- Migrating Neo4j data.
- Graphiti semantic extraction.
- GraphView/federation redesign.
- Falkor engine fork/modification.
- Public service deployment.
title: TRACE-GRAPH-FALKOR: FalkorDB operational projection and differential parity re-proof
